canonical_project: Southern Cross NEXT Kiritimati spur - Tabwakea Cable Landing Station
owner: Southern Cross Cable Network; landing station operated by BwebwerikiNet Limited (BNL)
notes: Cable landing station (asset class: cable landing / interconnection anchor, NOT a datacenter). Dedicated 377 km one-fibre-pair branch of Southern Cross NEXT to Tabwakea, Kiritimati (Line Islands), in service since July 2022; BNL operates/maintains the CLS (ADB IEE 50348-001; BNL LinkedIn; Submarine Networks; GeoCables). Station serves both Vodafone and Ocean Link mobile services on Kiritimati. NO datacenter facility or DC proposal verified in the Line Islands as of 2026-08-12 (diesel/solar power limits, no public proposal); World Bank US$110M Kiritimati growth grant (Feb 2025) is transport/economic-development context, not a datacenter project.
